summary.text: Bonnie Westlin is a Democratic state senator who has represented Minnesota Senate District 42 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and small business owner, she says her priorities include affordability, public schools and local infrastructure.

paragraphs.text: Bonnie Westlin was born in Minnesota and graduated from Armstrong Senior High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Hamline University in 1992 and a law degree from the Hamline University School of Law in 1995.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in the Northwest Metro for nearly 50 years, is a single mother of two sons and grandmother of two, and established a solo family law practice in 2004 that also offers mediation.
Westlin took office in the Minnesota Senate on January 3, 2023, succeeding Jason Isaacson.

In the survey, she said she helped secure Paid Family and Medical Leave and sick-and-safe time policies and that her first term included the largest special education funding increase in state history.
She also said she would advocate for funding to counties to offset federal cuts and for expanding the North Star Promise program.
